newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilniaus leads active banks on Lithuania bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vilniaus leads active banks on Lithuania bourse.

text.p: Lithuanian shares dipped on Friday by the close but activity in banks, headed by market leader Vilniaus Bankas, led to some optimism among brokers.
The bourse official index was down 6.84 points to 915.86 points by the close while the wider group A index dipped by 1.27 percent to 1869.12 points.
"Active trade in bank shares today and in the second half of the week gives us grounds for some optimism for next week," said Aiste Kraujalyte, a broker with Vilfima.
Vilniaus turned over a large 4.6 million litas, or 0.92 percent of its stock, the largest chunk of a high 6.55 million litas of block trades.
Vilniaus' block trade price ranged between 244 and 240 litas, compared with a Thursday close of 240 litas.
"I cannot deny that it was an institutional investor," said Kestutis Kvainauskas, a dealer with Vilniaus Bank, but declined to give further details.
Vilniaus on Friday said it would release its first half results on Monday and dealers expect them to be good.
Second-largest bank Hermis Bank maintained its rise and was traded at 203.5 litas, an increase of 3.5 litas, on turnover of 94,000 litas on the central market.
Another 333,000 litas deal with Hermis was registered in the block trades, prices ranging from 204 to 202 litas.
"I would expect higher activity among the official list shares next week," Kvainauskas said.
Rokishkis Cheese kept on gaining and advanced to 42 litas from 41.98 litas on 23,000 litas.
